fields.Name: T25 - Multiple Tab Workflow
fields.Description: Verifies the workspace tab feature: opening record tab(s) and switching between tabs.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box. Click a member row, then click 'Open Full Record' — this opens the member as a workspace TAB (record tab #1, alongside the Home tab). Then attempt a SECOND tab: go back to the grid, click a different row, and SHIFT+CLICK 'Open Full Record' (hold Shift while clicking) to open it in a NEW tab. Verify tab navigation: ideally TWO record tabs appear and you can switch between them; SUCCESS = at least one record tab opened AND tab navigation works (switching between the Home tab and a record tab, or between two record tabs, shows the correct content). Multi-tab via Shift+Click can be finicky — opening at least one record tab and demonstrating tab switching is sufficient. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: At least one record opened as a workspace tab (ideally two via Shift+Click)
Tab navigation works — switching tabs (Home<->record, or between two record tabs) shows the correct content
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
